subject.title: [Feature]: Network Access Control (allowedDomains / denyDomains) — Egress Firewall

question: Should OpenClaw expose this as a local `web_fetch` config surface, a managed-proxy boundary, or a broader cross-tool policy covering fetch, search, browser navigation, redirects, caches, and provider fallback?
rationale: This would become a public operator-trusted security boundary, and the open related PRs encode different answers that automation should not choose without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Approve scoped web_fetch allowlist first
options.body: Sponsor the narrow `web_fetch` hostname-allowlist path as an incremental first step while explicitly tracking denylist, search, and proxy coverage as follow-up work.

options.title: Make proxy policy canonical
options.body: Pause local `web_fetch` config additions and route application-owned egress through the managed proxy policy direction instead.

options.title: Require cross-tool design
options.body: Hold implementation until maintainers define one policy covering fetch, search, browser, provider fallback, redirects, caches, and plugin HTTP.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped web_fetch allowlist first
recommendation.body: Sponsor the narrow `web_fetch` hostname-allowlist path as an incremental first step while explicitly tracking denylist, search, and proxy coverage as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: The steipete-oai account owns the current open scoped implementation candidate and Peter Steinberger has relevant guarded-fetch history.
